features.apple: Shell > New Tab (cmd+T)
features.note: Cmd+T opens a tab in the home folder; More menu opens one in the current folder.

features.apple: Shell > New Window (cmd+N), New Window with profile
features.note: One terminal per desktop window; no new-window action inside the app. Not started: Shell holds one tab set (Shell::term), so a second window needs that split first.
features.wire: Add TermKey::NewWindow to hwkeys.rs (cmd+N) that asks the shell to open a second Terminal window with its own tab set; terminal state (self.term) then needs a per-window TabSet instead of one on Shell.

features.feature: Tab strip with close buttons and Cmd+1..9
features.apple: tab bar, select tab, next/previous tab
features.note: Compact tab strip, close box, Cmd+1 to 9, next and previous tab shortcuts.

features.feature: Reorder tabs and move a tab to a new window
features.apple: Window > Move Tab to New Window, Move Tab Left/Right, drag tabs
features.note: More > Move tab left and Move tab right reorder the tab bar, and the active tab and a split pair follow their sessions. The order rule is tested headless in tests/parity_app-terminal.rs. Gap: dragging a tab name along the bar, and Move Tab to New Window, which needs several windows.
features.wire: Move Tab to New Window once multiple windows exist (see New window).

features.feature: Close tab, close other tabs, reopen closed
features.apple: Shell > Close Tab, Close Other Tabs
features.note: Close Tab (Cmd+W, File menu), Close Other Tabs and Reopen Closed Tab (More) are in the code. The Midget check is pending.
features.wire: Verify on Midget that Cmd+W, Close Other Tabs and Reopen Closed Tab act on the intended tabs, including a tab with a running process.

features.feature: Prompt before closing a running process
features.apple: Inspector Prompt before closing; close alert
features.note: Second Cmd+W confirms when the tab has a foreground job.

features.apple: Shell > New Command… (run a command in a new window)
features.note: Command panel runs the line through /bin/sh -c in a new tab that closes at exit.

features.apple: Shell > New Remote Connection: service list, server list, user, Connect
features.note: Connections panel from the SSH config with add/edit form and import; no Bonjour server browser, no telnet or user-name toggle.
features.wire: Add a discovered-servers list to the Connections panel from the dns_browse service browser (_ssh._tcp) and a telnet service row.

features.apple: CFBundleURLTypes ssh://, telnet://
features.note: The Terminal declares ssh and telnet (shell/defaultapps.rs:39). Open link in selection runs an ssh or telnet link in a new tab as an argv of validated words, so no option reaches the command; the argv rules are tested headless in tests/parity_app-terminal.rs. Gap: a tap on a link in the output does not open it yet, and there is no server browser.
features.wire: Offer the server browser (see New Remote Connection) from the links and the Connections panel.

features.feature: x-man-page URL and man page services
features.apple: x-man-page scheme; Open man Page, Search man Page Index services
features.note: Open man page for selection and Open link in selection run man in a new tab. An x-man-page link is read as an optional section and a page name with the same word checks, and the rule is tested headless. Gap: no Services entries for the man page index and no index search.
features.wire: Add the Services entries for the man page index.

features.apple: Services: New Terminal / New Tab at Folder, Files Open in Terminal
features.note: Services > New Terminal at Folder opens a Terminal tab in the selected folder, or in the folder of a selected file (services_route.rs used the file's own path before this fix). Files Open in Terminal (files/menu.rs) was already built. Needs a check on Midget.
features.wire: Check Open in Terminal from a file and a folder, and the Services entry, on Midget.

features.feature: Open a .command or executable file in Terminal
features.apple: document types: shell script, unix-executable
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/terminal/open.rs:10 (open_argv), open.rs:31 (terminal_open_documents); springboard/src/shell/workspace.rs:303 (OpenFile hands the granted files to Terminal)
features.note: A .command file, or an executable, that the workspace opens with Terminal runs in its own new tab in its own folder, through a /bin/sh wrapper that takes the path as an argument. The tab stays at a login shell when the program ends. Other files are refused with a message. Tested: open_argv refuses relative paths and non-runnable files and never splices the path into the script (open.rs tests).
features.wire: Check on Midget: Open With > Terminal on a .command and on an executable from Files. A Terminal that was not running also opens its default tab. Confirm that .command has a Terminal document type (shell/defaultapps.rs:39 lists public.shell-script only), and that Services and drop on the Dock are not wired yet.

features.apple: Shell > Save as Window Group, Open Window Group
features.note: Save window group stores each tab's folder under a name, and Open window group reopens one from the list; the encoding is tested in groups.rs. Gap: the running command of a tab is not recorded, and no group opens at launch.
features.wire: Record the running command of each tab when a group is saved.

features.apple: Settings > Profiles: Basic, Pro, Homebrew, Ocean, Novel, Red Sands, Silver Aerogel, Clear Dark/Light
features.note: More > Color theme cycles the terminal core's colour themes, and profile_table.rs holds the nine profiles with their colours (Basic follows the scheme). Gap: there is no profile list or Use at Launch, and a profile's text size, caret and opacity are not applied.
features.wire: Apply each profile text size and caret, and its opacity (see Window background image and translucency).

features.feature: Profile editor: ANSI colours, bold, blink, text
features.apple: Profiles > Text: font, character and line spacing, ANSI colours, bright for bold, antialias, blinking text
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/terminal/look_panel.rs (Profile Editor, More row 38); springboard/src/term/look.rs (Look, saved and from_prefs); springboard/src/term/render.rs (cell_pair, Metrics::with_spacing); springboard/src/term/mod.rs (set_look)
features.note: Profile Editor (More > Profile Editor): 16 ANSI colour wells with red, green and blue steppers, Reset palette to theme, Bold as Bright, Allow Blink, character and line spacing steppers (0.8 to 2.0) and the cursor style. Saved in prefs as terminal.look.*, applied to every tab and to new tabs; the grid paints with the palette and the spacing. Tested: palette persistence round trip (look.rs), spacing changes the cell metrics (render.rs, term/mod.rs). Allow Blink is stored but nothing blinks yet.
features.wire: Allow Blink needs an SGR 5 (blink) attribute in the iosterm core: its cell attributes use all eight bits. The font picker and the window background image (see Window background image and translucency) are still missing.

features.apple: Cursor: Block, Underline, Vertical bar; Blink cursor
features.note: Style and blink stored in prefs and applied to every tab.

features.feature: Text size: bigger, smaller, actual size
features.apple: View > Bigger, Smaller (cmd + / -)
features.note: Cmd+plus, Cmd+minus and actual size; zoom steps saved.

features.apple: Profiles > Window: background image, opacity, blur
features.note: Clear profile alpha exists in the table but the view paints opaque.
features.wire: Paint the profile alpha through the compositor in view.rs and add an image slot to the profile editor.

features.apple: Settings > General: shell, new windows open with profile, startup window group
features.note: The Terminal always starts the login shell /bin/bash -l (term/mod.rs SHELL). Gap: no shell choice, no startup command, no Use at Launch profile and no window group at launch; a per-window default profile waits on several windows.
features.wire: Multiple windows: each new window opens with the default profile (see New window).

features.apple: Edit > Find (panel with Ignore Case, Wrap Around, Not found), Find Next/Previous, Use Selection for Find
features.note: Find, Find Next and Find Previous, and Use Selection for Find (Cmd+E) work. Matching always ignores case. Gap: the Find panel has no Ignore Case or Wrap Around switches, and wrapping needs options in the terminal core search.
features.wire: Add Ignore Case and Wrap Around toggles to the Find panel.

features.apple: Edit > Copy, Paste, Select All; paste selection, paste escaped text
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/terminal/menus.rs (terminal_menu_action: Copy selection, Paste, Paste escaped text, Paste selection)
features.note: Paste Escaped Text and Paste Selection added to the More menu (rows 25, 26); no key equivalents yet.
features.wire: Give Paste Selection a key equivalent.

features.feature: Copy Special: plain text and without background colour
features.apple: Edit > Copy Special
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/terminal/copy.rs:33 (terminal_copy_special); springboard/src/term/rtf.rs (to_rtf); springboard/src/term/mod.rs (selected_runs, selected_rtf); springboard/src/shell/terminal/menus.rs:172-174 (More rows 36 to 38); springboard/src/shell/desktop_bar.rs (Edit > Copy Special)
features.note: Edit > Copy Special has Plain Text (Copy), Text with Colors (RTF with each cell colour and the background) and Without Background Colour (RTF with the foreground only). Both colour copies put plain text and public.rtf on the shell pasteboard, and the RTF is offered to Wayland clients. The RTF writer is local to the Terminal because the SDK writer (sdk/attributed.rs to_rtf) only takes named colour tokens; it follows the same escaping. Tested: RTF of a styled selection (rtf.rs, term/mod.rs copy_special test).
features.wire: Check on Midget that a rich-text app pastes the coloured text. The two colour copies have no key equivalents; they are Edit menu and More rows only.

features.apple: double click word, triple click line, option-drag rectangle
features.note: Long press drag, double and triple tap select; no rectangular selection.
features.wire: Add option+drag rectangular selection in termtouch.rs.

features.apple: View > Allow Mouse Reporting
features.note: More menu row Allow mouse reporting turns mouse and wheel reports off for all tabs (saved). No option+drag rectangle yet.
features.wire: Report pointer movement without a button (mode 1003) from pointer events.

features.apple: Terminal > Secure Keyboard Entry
features.note: Toggle keeps shell shortcuts out of the terminal, saved.

features.apple: Edit > Mark as Bookmark, Insert Bookmark, Jump to Previous/Next Mark, Marks menu
features.note: The OSC 133 prompt parser (osc133_prompts) is tested in profile_table.rs, but nothing feeds its results into the scrollback yet, so no line is marked. Gap: Mark as Bookmark (Cmd+U), mark navigation with Cmd+Up and Cmd+Down, bookmarks and a Marks menu are not built.
features.wire: Keep marks across a full scrollback (the iosterm core needs to report how many lines it dropped), name bookmarks and list them in a panel.

features.apple: scrollback limit, Clear Scrollback (cmd+K), Clear to Start
features.note: Clear Scrollback (cmd+K), Reset, Clear Screen (Ctrl+L), Save scrollback to Files.

features.apple: Shell > Export Text As…, Save Selected Text As…
features.note: Save scrollback to Files and Save selected text to Files write fixed file names in the Files folder. Gap: no save panel, so the folder and the name are not chosen by the user.
features.wire: Verify on Midget that Save scrollback and Save selected text write the expected content to Files; then wire the SDK save panel so users choose the name and folder.

features.apple: View > Split Pane
features.note: Two sessions side by side with a divider; close split.

features.feature: Show Inspector: title, process list, columns and rows
features.apple: Shell > Show Inspector (cmd+I): window title, running processes, size
features.note: The Processes panel lists the processes and offers Terminate and Force kill. Gap: columns and rows are neither shown nor editable there, and the tab title is set from More > Edit title.
features.wire: Add a Columns and Rows stepper to the Processes panel.

features.apple: Shell > Edit Title
features.note: More menu row Edit title sets a per-tab title (Terminal::set_custom_title); empty restores the automatic one. No Inspector field yet.
features.wire: Verify on Midget that a custom title appears on its tab and an empty title restores the automatic title.

features.apple: Edit > Open URL, Look Up, Search the Web; command-click links
features.note: Open link in selection opens the first web link in the browser, or runs the first ssh, telnet or x-man-page link in a new tab. Search the web for selection is in the More menu. Gap: no command-click on a link and no Look Up.
features.wire: Add Cmd+click on a link (pointer modifiers).

features.apple: View > Enter Full Screen, Show Tab Bar, Show All Tabs
features.note: Full screen is the window's Maximize / Restore in the File menu. Gap: there is no View > Show All Tabs, no Hide Tab Bar and no tab overview with previews.
features.wire: Add Hide Tab Bar and a tab overview with previews.

features.apple: AppleScript dictionary
features.note: state, read, resize and clear verbs over the control endpoint.

features.apple: Shell, Edit, View, Window, Help menus
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/desktop_bar.rs (Menu::File, Menu::Edit and Menu::View rows while the Terminal is in front)
features.note: While the Terminal is in front, the desktop menu bar adds New Tab and Close Tab (File), Find, Find Next, Find Previous and Clear Scrollback (Edit), and Bigger, Smaller and Actual Size (View). Gap: Profiles, Startup Command and Login Shell are not published as a Shell menu, and More rows such as Close Other Tabs and Paste Selection are not in the bar.
features.wire: Publish Profiles, Startup Command and Login Shell as a Shell menu through the menu bar API.

features.apple: Help > Terminal Help
features.note: More menu row Terminal help shows every Terminal shortcut from one table, checked by unit tests in extras.rs (keys unique, line in table order). Shown as a one-line message; no help page yet.
features.wire: Verify on Midget that Terminal help exposes the shortcut table and displayed shortcuts match the active key bindings.

features.apple: Low Memory panel: older scrollback discarded
features.note: Scrollback is capped by line count, not by memory pressure.
